description: [provider] Start an ICP segmentation from a list of domains. Create a new segmentation from a list of company domains (Ocean.io · Company data) (costs $0.001 per call, paid automatically: from your wallet via x402 or from prepaid credits (API key))

inputSchema.description: ASYNC but POLLABLE, unlike the webhook endpoints: it returns `segmentationId` immediately, then you poll oceanio.companies.segment.get until `status` is SUCCESSFUL. Free in our test. A handful of domains lands everything in one 'Other' segment — feed it a real list (dozens to hundreds) for useful clusters

domains.description: the companies to group — typically your customer list or best-fit accounts

leadScoringFeatures.description: which company attributes to cluster on, e.g. industries, technologies, company_size. Omit for the default set

negativeDomains.description: poor-fit companies — the segmentation leans away from these

numberOfSegmentsMode.description: bias toward fewer or more segments; omit to let the service choose

positiveDomains.description: good-fit companies — the segmentation leans toward companies like these

name: oceanio_companies_segment_create
